description: Remote authentication upstream calls are being rate-limited or are unavailable. Inspect the grouped operation/outcome and verify Hydra, Talos, and Kratos health before changing cache or retry policy.
mplQuery:
`moltnet-metrics`:`auth.remote.upstream.requests`
| where `outcome` == "rate_limited" or `outcome` == "unavailable"
| align to 1m using prom::rate
| group by `operation`, `outcome`, `service.name` using sum
name: MoltNet remote auth upstream failures
